BiblicalUsage: Remeth was a town in the inheritance of Issachar, named among the cities on the border of the tribe. Its fields lay on the border where Issachar met Zebulun, and the town is counted among the cities of the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the border towns are named because the inheritance was measured and given, not taken by chance.
